title: Ostomy Supply Program Running Period of a Convex Barrier Liability Notice
content:
How long an Ostomy Supply Program liability notice for convex barriers (A4407) runs replaces the one standard supply of 30-day blocks and follows the written order: where the newest written order's valid-through date is at least 360 days away and the program has shipped at least two convex-barrier refills, the notice runs for twelve 30-day blocks; where the valid-through date is fewer than 360 days and at least 30 days away, it runs for the whole 30-day blocks to that date; otherwise it runs for one standard supply.

Days to the valid-through date are counted in calendar days from today to the valid-through date of the newest written order for the convex barrier; whole 30-day blocks are those days divided by 30, rounded down.

| Newest written order and refill history | Notice's 30-day blocks |
|---|---|
| Valid-through date at least 360 days away, and at least 2 convex-barrier refills shipped on the program | 12 |
| Valid-through date fewer than 360 and at least 30 days away | Whole 30-day blocks to that date |
| Otherwise | One standard supply: the tier's standard supply days divided by 30 |

**One standard supply by tier.** 1 block (30 days) on the Ostomy Self-Pay Program, Ostomy Commercial HMO Program and Ostomy Medicaid Program; 3 blocks (90 days) on the Ostomy Commercial PPO Program, Ostomy Medicare Advantage Program and Ostomy Original Medicare Program.

**Cases (hypothetical).**
- Order valid 400 more days, 3 refills shipped: 12 blocks.
- Order valid 400 more days, 1 refill shipped: the first row fails and the second does not apply (not fewer than 360), so one standard supply.
- Order valid 300 more days: 10 blocks (300 divided by 30).
- Order valid 200 more days: fewer than 360, so the whole blocks to that date: 200 divided by 30, rounded down, is 6 blocks.
- Order valid 25 more days: one standard supply.
